comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over the same sources, and both require an explicit acknowledgment of validity followed by something else in the same comment. The follow-on element differs. Item 0 accepts any disagreement, discrepancy or counter-point, which includes a full rejection of the view. Item 1 requires a narrower, specific caveat, exception or qualification and explicitly excludes a blanket rejection of the whole view. Item 1 is therefore a narrower subtype. The null rules also differ. Item 0 returns null when the OP context is missing, and item 1 returns null only when OC_comments is missing or malformed. So the row functions are not the same.
